EVIDENCE BUDGET

10 scoring benchmarks

Academic and professional knowledge Humanity's Last Exam 15% Scientific and research-grade reasoning GPQA Diamond — AA 5× pass@1 10% Evidence, data, and long-context synthesis GDP.pdf — AA All-pass, No Tools 10% Scientific and research-grade reasoning CritPt — Research Physics, No Tools 15% Mathematical and formal reasoning LiveBench Mathematics — 2026-06-25 10% Abstract reasoning and novel transfer LiveBench Reasoning — 2026-06-25 10% Evidence, data, and long-context synthesis LiveBench Data Analysis — 2026-06-25 5% Evidence, data, and long-context synthesis Artificial Analysis Long Context Reasoning v1.1 5% Epistemic reliability AA-Omniscience — Knowledge & Hallucination 10% Abstract reasoning and novel transfer ARC-AGI-2 — Verified CoT, No Tools 10%

HOW TO READ

A blank is not a hidden score

Real head-to-heads

Two models produce a win, loss, or tie only when both have a valid score on the same benchmark. A missing score is never written as a loss.

Joint Bradley–Terry fit

All weighted pairwise outcomes estimate latent ability together. A weak prior only damps extreme values when evidence is thin.

Coverage is not a penalty

Coverage is the share of the frozen evidence budget a model actually has. It drives the confidence label; it is not subtracted from the score.

Auditable to each board

Open any model to inspect each benchmark's score, weight, reasoning effort, version, and source.

Ranking method adapted from AIHOT.

RELEASE HISTORY

What changed

  1. 2026-09-05

    GDP.pdf joins the KSR basket

    GDP.pdf now contributes 10% through Artificial Analysis All-pass scores; all active sources were refreshed.

    Version 3.6 replaces the retired academic multiple-choice slot with professional document reasoning. GDP.pdf uses AA All-pass over 100 tasks and five attempts per task, in one turn without tools or browsing. AA now refreshes its complete public model catalog, including configurations outside the default chart selection. AA-LCR is recorded as v1.1. The ten-benchmark basket still totals 100%; anchors and the effort-first selection rule remain fixed. Retired source data and integration code have been removed from the maintained project.

  2. 2026-09-05

    GPT-6 Astra coverage completed

    The latest refresh adds Astra's LiveBench max-effort evaluation and updates its Artificial Analysis measurements.

    LiveBench now includes GPT-6 Astra (max), while Artificial Analysis refreshed the Astra configuration scores. The model is merged across its available benchmark rows and now reaches 90% KSR coverage; the scoring method and ten-benchmark basket are unchanged.

  3. 2026-09-04

    Astra and Gemini 3.8 Flash benchmark refresh

    The enabled benchmark snapshots were refreshed again and the latest Astra, Gemini, Muse, and K2 configurations were added to the board.

    The benchmark sources enabled at the time were refreshed. GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3, and K2 Horizon 375B A23B now have cross-source identities where available; the scoring method and frozen ten-benchmark basket are unchanged.

  4. 2026-09-02

    September benchmark refresh and Fable 5.1 added

    All enabled benchmark snapshots were refreshed and the newly measured Fable 5.1 family is now represented on the board.

    The benchmark sources enabled at the time were refreshed. The update adds Claude Fable 5.1 configurations across the available sources, plus GLM-5.3 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash Next, and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B; model aliases were added where source naming needed explicit identity mapping.

  5. 2026-08-22

    Fresh benchmark snapshots ingested

    The enabled source snapshots were refreshed and new model configurations were added to the board.

    LiveBench adds Qwen3.8 27B, Ox Alpha max, and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental; ARC-AGI-2 adds eight verified CoT configurations. Artificial Analysis was rechecked and its retained catalog was updated.

  6. 2026-08-19

    GLM-5.3 added from Artificial Analysis

    AA now reports GLM-5.3 (max). KSR ingested those native no-tool scores and rebuilt the board.

    Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, CritPt, Long Context Reasoning, and Omniscience use the new AA catalog row. Other sources are unchanged.

  7. 2026-08-18

    HLE now uses Artificial Analysis only

    Every HLE score on the board comes from the AA text-only catalog. The official Scale board is no longer mixed in.

    Models that only appeared on the Scale HLE board lose that score unless AA also measured them. Other benchmarks are unchanged.

  8. 2026-08-18

    Anchor models no longer compared with themselves

    The consensus score is the mean predicted win rate against the other frozen anchors. A model that is itself an anchor is no longer given a free 50% against itself.

    This changes displayed KSR scores slightly, more so for the twelve frozen anchors. Benchmark weights and the one-model-one-row selection rule are unchanged.

  9. 2026-08-18

    KSR leaderboard launched

    A public board for knowledge, science, and reasoning — not agents, not coding harnesses.

    KSR is now public. The first board scores models on ten frozen benchmarks, using each host's native input modality and excluding known tool, agent, and program-search runs. One model appears once. Missing scores stay blank.

KSR v3.6.0 · A score is not a complete measure of human intelligence.
